extraction.Name: William Courtis
extraction.NOTES: Document concerns William Courtis, Jr. (Dec'd), with William Courtis appearing as heir/witness. William Courtis, Jr. died Sep. 26, 1922 (as best readable). He received a fee patent for his allotment. Questionnaire asks whether he made application, mortgaged the land, sold it, whether heir still owns land, and whether he left any children. Responses are partially legible. Sworn before a Notary Public on the 9th day of [month] 1929. File reference: No. 50 William Courtis, Jr. Dec'd.
